notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's mail writer defines ten sends (GET_MAIL_LIST, SEND_MAIL, TAKE_MONEY, TAKE_ITEM, MARK_AS_READ, RETURN_TO_SENDER, DELETE, CREATE_TEXT_ITEM, ITEM_TEXT_QUERY, MSG_QUERY_NEXT_MAIL_TIME). MSUI sends all ten and handles SMSG_MAIL_LIST_RESULT, SMSG_SEND_MAIL_RESULT, SMSG_ITEM_TEXT_QUERY_RESPONSE, SMSG_RECEIVED_MAIL and the MSG_QUERY_NEXT_MAIL_TIME reply.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The pre-pass 'missing' SMSG_SHOW_MAILBOX is a false positive: Benilla documents (messages/mail.rs, opcode.rs) that no SMSG_SHOW_MAILBOX exists on build 5875 - the mailbox window opens entirely client-side.
